headlines.headline: Michigan Reloads as Champion; Katz Drops First 2026-27 Bracket Predictions
headlines.detail: Reigning champ Michigan has rebuilt impressively since the title on April 6. Andy Katz released his first bracket for the newly expanded 76-team tournament. NBA draft withdrawal deadline is May 27.

headlines.headline: Pistons-Cavaliers and Spurs-Wolves Both in Game 6 Tonight
headlines.detail: Cavs host Detroit at 7 PM ET (Cavs lead 3-2). Spurs at Minnesota at 9:30 PM ET (Spurs lead 3-2). Both could clinch tonight.

headlines.headline: 2026 NFL Schedule Released; Seahawks Open vs. Patriots in Super Bowl LX Rematch
headlines.detail: Seattle opens its title defense Sept. 9 vs. New England. Record nine international games. Season opens on a Wednesday for only the second time ever.

headlines.headline: Transfer Portal Winds Down; LSU and Penn State Lead Monster Classes
headlines.detail: LSU (Lane Kiffin) assembled ~40 transfers. Penn State added ~20 with coach Matt Campbell from Iowa State, including QB Rocco Becht, the cycle's top signal-caller move.
